summary: Implemented `adl codefriend plan tests` as a bounded test-plan generator over accepted review synthesis output. It maps traceable synthesized findings to behavior under test, source evidence, proposed test location, fixture/input guidance, expected pre-fix failure, expected post-fix assertion, validation lane/resource notes, detection rationale, and non-goals. Findings without repository paths are omitted with explicit reasons. Publication remains held until exact-head review and base strategy are safe.
